source: HIQA Corporate Plan 2025-2027, Section 5 (public document), actions lightly abridged

outcomes.name: HIQA's standard setting, monitoring and regulation of quality and safety are enabling improved outcomes for the people of Ireland
actions: Fulfil statutory and regulatory responsibilities and publish reports on findings across healthcare, radiation, IPAS centres, older person, disability and children's services, and health information
Implement the extended remit of the Chief Inspector, including reviews of specified incidents, new data collection regulations and home support regulations
Conduct statutory investigations and reviews based on potential risks and emergent needs
Prepare for and commence new responsibilities such as NIS-2, Critical Entities Resilience, the Human Tissue Act and home support
Set and update national standards based on stakeholder priorities
Conduct a risk-based approach to regulation of health and social care services
Monitor adherence to Open Disclosure and report annually to the Minister
Develop surveillance and data analytics capabilities to support risk-based monitoring

outcomes.name: HIQA is influencing and enabling service providers to deliver improved service user experiences and better outcomes
actions: Enable sustained quality improvement through inspection, reporting, risk escalation and enforcement
Extend the National Care Experience Programme to cancer and mental health services, including hard-to-reach groups
Engage with service user advocacy and provider groups to share learning from regulation
Support quality improvement by involving providers and service users in guidance and learning supports
Use data and analytics to share learning across HIQA-overseen sectors
Further embed a human rights-based approach
Publish annual overview reports to support learning across the sector
Review the effectiveness of regulatory processes following developments in the nursing home sector

outcomes.name: HIQA provides evidence to inform policy decisions and practice developments across health and social care services and at a population level
actions: Promote and support evidence-based decision-making in policy and services
Set national health information standards in line with Digital for Care and the European Health Data Space Regulation
Host the National Immunisation Advisory Committee and provide its secretariat
Undertake health technology assessments and evidence syntheses, and publish evidence-based advice
Develop a strategic research function and academic partnerships
Develop an ethical and safe use guidance framework for AI in health and social care
Support the development of an Evidence Synthesis Hub for future health crises

outcomes.name: HIQA is delivering value and impact for all stakeholders through agile and collaborative ways of working, efficient systems, fit-for-purpose structures, and appropriate governance
actions: Review the Target Operating Model, including how AI and data analytics could improve operational performance
Drive cross-functional working to improve effectiveness and efficiency
Evaluate HIQA's impact using specific impact measures
Develop and implement a Digital and Data Strategy
Develop and implement a Quality, Risk and Compliance Strategy 2026–2028
Maintain and build partnerships to support the outcomes

outcomes.name: HIQA is a sustainable and inclusive organisation
actions: Progress implementation of the Climate Action Plan
Develop and implement Diversity, Equality and Inclusion plans
Adhere to Corporate Sustainability Reporting Directive requirements

outcomes.name: HIQA is an employer of choice through its staff supports, opportunities and positive organisational culture
actions: Develop and implement a People and Culture Strategy 2025–2027
Execute strategic workforce plans for the future operating model
Develop and implement a Learning and Development Strategy
Develop an employee engagement strategy and plan
